# Banking Data Privacy Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Banking

## Overview

Use when managing banking customer data privacy including GLBA privacy notices, opt-out processing, CCPA/CPRA consumer rights handling, and cross-border data transfer compliance for banking operations.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [banking-data-privacy-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
banking-data-privacy-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@banking-data-privacy` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Generate and deliver GLBA initial and annual privacy notices
- Process customer opt-out requests for information sharing
- Handle CCPA/CPRA consumer rights: access, deletion, correction, and opt-out of sale
- Classify banking data by sensitivity: NPI, PII, account data, transaction data

## Industry Standards Applied

- **GLBA (Reg P)**: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act privacy of consumer financial information
- **CCPA/CPRA**: California Consumer Privacy Act consumer data rights
- **GDPR**: EU General Data Protection Regulation for banking customers
